"What's the most useful thing you've learned since we got here?"
"The fundamental skill. Everything else is decoration."
"Still on the most useful thing you've learned."
"Walk my trap line with me? Extra hands, extra eyes."
Øyvind shows you where they go to think. "Don't tell the others. Everyone needs one place."
"Never mind. You had something to say?"
"Huh. Let me think about that." "Brianna is gone and the world just... continues. That's the part I can't stand."
"A name. Okay." You say it out loud, trying the shape of it:

"Roles. Not ranks — promises."

"Sure. I'll be around."
"Good talk. I feel like I know you a little better now."
They're smiling as you go. "Come back anytime."
"Can I tell you something? I've been skimming extra food. I'm ashamed and I can't stop."
"I needed someone to know — just one person. Thank you for being that person, as it were."
"Okay, real question: what's the funniest thing you've seen since we got here? I desperately need it."
"Take your time."
"Still on that question."
"Okay. Yeah. I trust you."
"Rest when you can. We'll talk again soon."

"When's the last time you really laughed?"

"Still on the last time you laughed. That's where we are."
"Someone should watch your back. Might as well be me."
"That can wait — it isn't going anywhere. What's on your mind?"
"Good question." "Brianna owed me a favor. I keep thinking about collecting. Stupid."
"I wake before anyone else. It doesn't bring anyone back. It just keeps my hands from shaking."
"Roles. Not ranks — promises."

"We bury, we grieve, we keep going. There's no step four."

lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Brianna Nikolaev is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Brianna is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d41: Thornfield watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d41: 🕯️ Brianna Nikolaev is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Brianna kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Brianna's gone." Emilio looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Brianna." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Hayden blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Animal Behavior (Level 1). Most animals flee. Give them an escape route and they take it. Cornered animals fight.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Come Get Some (Level 1). Make exactly the right noise and the blind thing comes to investigate. Goad a blinded monster within 3 tiles: it lurches toward the sound on its next move. Stand where you want it.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Scarecrow (Level 1). You can stage a fake injury to lure monsters into traps. They fall for it. Every time.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Brianna Nikolaev, 41 days. The mantle passes to Hayden Freeman.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Hayden Freeman, 50 — a hunting guide. Their hands know different work now: Night Eyes, Lucky Rock, Trophy Room, Bloodhound, Green Whisper.
d41: ◈ The System updates its file: the new bearer <redacted> "Stalker of the Apex Predator." It had a word for this one before the Codex came.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Brianna — and Brianna is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Emilio, Chester, Øyvind and 6 more speak for Hayden — "Brianna trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Hayden before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
